correctness.rationale: In orthogonal coordinates every face projection is explicit and strictly interior. The normal-fan cells have d independent opposite facet pairs, yielding exactly 2^d vertices matching every face projection; standard cubical incidence gives bipolarity, orthogonality comes from projection, and normal-fan geometry proves the tiling. Reconstructed exact rational checks run in dimensions 2–6; they are not substituted for the all-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: The higher-dimensional orthogonal-kernel to cutout-tiling implication is explicitly posed as an open problem. This identifies an infinite natural nonregular class in every dimension, proves the implication for the full interior kernel (not one distinguished center), and gives complete explicit cell inequalities and 2^d vertex certificates, useful in geometric cubical meshing.
